plugins.name: Better Cores
plugins.summary: Keeps the panel's cores up to date from Settings → Cores (OpenFlux, mieru, TrustTunnel) and carries the WARP engine Better WARP builds on
plugins.author: AllIsA1

verified.notes: Reviewed by the author. api:cores:write only downloads OpenFlux, mieru, TrustTunnel via the panel, which checks the SHA-256. api:server:read: panel version. Network: GitHub, WARP ranges. Needs host-11

plugins.name: Better CSQTT
plugins.summary: One CSQTT password per person: each client of the inbound gets a member and their own link, so several people can use CSQTT at once
plugins.author: AllIsA1

verified.notes: Reviewed by the author. Reads the CSQTT inbound and its clients; calls the CSQTT server's own web API with its web password (network); only members it made are touched; falls back to the shared link.

plugins.name: Better LucX
plugins.summary: AmneziaWG config link for every client, plain CSQTT links, CSQTT and OpenFlux names on the subscription page
plugins.author: AllIsA1

verified.notes: Reviewed by the author. Reads inbounds; takes part in subscription answers only (seam:sub); no stored data, no network, no page. Falls back to the panel.

plugins.name: Better olcRTC
plugins.summary: Does nothing now: the panel brings the olcRTC fork itself since lucx.325; can be removed
plugins.author: AllIsA1

verified.notes: Reviewed by the author. No permissions, no page; answers the health check only.

plugins.name: Better OpenFlux
